purpose: Recovery execution support: use BLACK for bounded local history/dedupe analysis of the surviving LayerZero failed-native-drop signal instead of repeating narrative revalidation.
done: Receipt must show source/history evidence for _nativeDrop/nativeDropAndExecute302 semantics, including commits touching the relevant code and current/frozen code context, so Reaper can promote, kill, or narrow the signal.
command:
set -euo pipefail
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
git clone -q https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/LayerZero-v2.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
git checkout -q 9c741e7f9790639537b1710a203bcdfd73b0b9ac
echo '=== FROZEN COMMIT ==='
git rev-parse HEAD
echo '=== SYMBOL LOCATIONS ==='
grep -R -n -E '(_nativeDrop|nativeDropAndExecute302)' . --exclude-dir=.git | head -80 || true
echo '=== HISTORY TOUCHING _nativeDrop ==='
git log --all --date=iso --pretty=format:'%H %ad %s' -S'_nativeDrop' -- . | head -40 || true
echo
echo '=== HISTORY TOUCHING nativeDropAndExecute302 ==='
git log --all --date=iso --pretty=format:'%H %ad %s' -S'nativeDropAndExecute302' -- . | head -40 || true
echo
echo '=== RELEVANT FILE CONTEXT ==='
for f in $(grep -R -l -E '(_nativeDrop|nativeDropAndExecute302)' . --exclude-dir=.git | head -12); do
  echo "--- $f ---"
  grep -n -C 14 -E '(_nativeDrop|nativeDropAndExecute302)' "$f" | head -220 || true
done
